----Respondents For Petitioner(s) : Mr.Ashok Kumar, Adv.
For Respondent(s) : Mr.Mool Singh Bhati, PP  Mr.M.S.Bhat, Adv.
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 20/01/2023

The instant misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioner-complainant with the limited prayer that the Investigating Agency may be directed to conduct fair and impartial investigation in FIR No.594/2022 registered at Police Station Ratangarh,
Distt. Churu for offence under Sections 498-A, 406 & 376-D of IPC.

Learned Public Prosecutor submits that the Investigating agency is already conducting free and fair investigation, however, if any material is brought on record by the petitioner the same shall be considered by the prosecution strictly in accordance with law before completing the investigation.

] Taking into account all the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner is directed to submit a detailed representation before the concerned Inspector General of Police as well as the Investigating Officer within a period of 15 days from today, who shall take up all the facts as well as contentions raised in the representation and complete the investigation by considering them strictly in accordance with law.
The instant misc. petition is disposed of accordingly.
Stay Petition also stands disposed of.
